newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Wednesday.

"Rates were narrowly mixed in the morning on some position adjustments amid uncertainty over market direction. There's no (U.S.) economic indicators coming out tonight but some people are waiting for more clues to market direction from Thursday's release of the weekly jobless claims figures," a dealer said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday rose 1/8 percentage point to 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, Thursday/Friday rose 1/16 point to 5-3/8 5-1/4 and week-fixed rose 1/16 point to 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent.
Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8 and six-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
